notes: HER 0.1.0-hashi.15 adds one-writer persistent sessions, isolated full-context scheduler and concurrent turns, local tool-call/result sequence validation, session quarantine after failed turns, and request-correlated structured provider diagnostics with targeted secret redaction. Habit failure audits now prefer error_kind over the terminal event kind. It retains the DeepSeek text-only image routing and multilingual OCR path certified in 0.1.0-hashi.14. Linux and Windows x86-64 packages are built from the same clean source commit.
